description: System boundary diagram for rust-MQTT as a Safety Element Out Of Context (SEOOC)

in_scope.name: rust_mqtt library (src/lib.rs)
in_scope.role: Root crate, re-exports all public API

in_scope.name: Client trait (src/client.rs)
in_scope.role: Abstract transport interface: publish, subscribe, close

in_scope.name: v3 TCP client (src/v3/)
in_scope.role: MQTT v3.1.1 over TCP; real broker connection

in_scope.name: Embedded broker (src/broker/)
in_scope.role: Minimal TCP broker for integration tests only

in_scope.name: RELAY adapter (src/adapt.rs)
in_scope.role: Adapts Client to relay::Node for crossbar routing

in_scope.name: Message types (src/message.rs)
in_scope.role: MQTT Message, QoS, UserProperty; v5 properties

in_scope.name: Error types (src/error.rs)
in_scope.role: Error enum with RELAY sentinel mapping

in_scope.name: CLI binary (src/bin/main.rs)
in_scope.role: RELAY §11 CLI: version, capabilities, status, send, subscribe, convert

out_of_scope.name: MQTT broker (Mosquitto / HiveMQ / AWS IoT)
out_of_scope.role: Server-side broker — not part of this library

out_of_scope.name: TLS termination
out_of_scope.role: TLS/mTLS handled by rustls (tls feature); broker provides cert

out_of_scope.name: Tokio async runtime
out_of_scope.role: External dependency; rust-MQTT assumes tokio is initialized by caller

out_of_scope.name: Vehicle application
out_of_scope.role: Integrating application; responsible for ASIL-D system-level safety goals

out_of_scope.name: Operating system / network stack
out_of_scope.role: TCP sockets provided by OS; not qualified by this element

out_of_scope.name: RELAY crossbar daemon
out_of_scope.role: Runtime crossbar; rust-MQTT provides relay::Node adapter, not the daemon itself

interfaces.description: Application calls publish/subscribe/close via the Client trait
Application calls adapt(client) → relay::Node for crossbar registration
MQTT v3.1.1 wire protocol over TCP; TLS optional
relay::Node::send and relay::Node::subscribe for message exchange
RELAY §11 contract: JSON on stdout, NDJSON on stdin for send/convert
All publish/subscribe paths call match_topic for delivery routing
to_message/from_message convert between MQTT and RELAY message types

trust_boundaries.description: Network boundary: data from MQTT broker is untrusted
Process boundary: CLI stdin is untrusted
Application boundary: caller-provided topics and payloads
trust_boundaries.risk: Empty topics, oversized payloads, invalid QoS values

safety_boundary_notes: rust-MQTT is a SEOOC (ISO 26262 Part 8 §6). It does not perform system-level HARA.
ASIL-B is claimed for all library functions listed in E-01 through E-11.
The embedded broker (E-05) is QM — test-only, never deployed in vehicle.
ASIL decomposition: applications requiring ASIL-D functions must duplicate the communication path independently.
Trust boundary TB-01 (network) is mitigated by length-checked parsing and no unsafe code.
